name: PT Trimegah Bangun Persada Tbk
summary: PT Trimegah Bangun Persada Tbk primarily focuses on nickel ore extraction and processing within Indonesia. The company manages and operates two active nickel laterite mining projects, covering an area of 5,524 hectares, situated in Kawasi and Loji on Obi Island. Additionally, it holds concessions for two potential nickel mining sites located in the Tabuji-Laiwui and Jikodolong villages in Indonesia. Beyond mining, the firm manufactures non-ferrous base metals and offers specialized laboratory testing along with various management advisory services. Its business activities also include trading and consultancy. Founded in 2004, PT Trimegah Bangun Persada Tbk is headquartered in Jakarta Pusat, Indonesia, and functions as a subsidiary of PT Harita Jayaraya inc.
